name: GitHub phase orchestrator
description: Monitors dependencies between issues, unblocks downstream phases when pull requests are merged, and applies the OpenHands trigger label.
exampleImplementation: A deterministic scheduled scanner checks all open issues carrying the blocked label. When all prerequisite issues or PRs are completed, it lifts the blocked status and attaches the openhands trigger label to kick off the next development phase.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to check for completed phases and unlock dependent issues.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved Agent Server secret.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: Label to apply when an issue is unblocked.
